newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Nikkei futures end firm but within range.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Nikkei futures end firm but within range.

text.p: SIMEX Nikkei futures ended higher on Monday after moving in a narrow 200-points range in very light trade.
Dealers said interest was dampened by a lack of fresh leads and a U.S. holiday.
Nikkei 225 June futures ended up 155 points at 20,160, 10 points below their intra-day high, on volume of 8,375 lots.
"If you look at today's high and low, I think it would have been better to stay home," a trader with a local institution said.
He said the market had already factored in the fallout from Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank's role in a racketeer payoff scandal.
Sentiment was helped by the fact that the bank was the only one of Japan's top 10 commercial banks to post a loss in the 1996/97 financial year, he added.
Dealers said the June Nikkei was likely to continue moving sideways unless it broke out of its current 19,750-20,400 range.
The May MSCI Taiwan index contract ended at 353.5 against its opening 351.5 on volume of 422 lots.
